title: Arcanus Canon Database — Volumes I and II
scope: Original v0.2 extraction preserved, expanded with Volume II (combined PDF pages 11–21). Not a full extraction of all 12 volumes.
editorial_notes: Not a full extraction of all 12 volumes.
Malcolm and Star birth surname Brightblade follows later approved genealogy; Chronicle uses their later-known names.
Do not infer parentage from monarch succession.
Only events explicitly labelled planned are future campaign events.
No precise dates assigned where Chronicle leaves them unknown.
Stage 5: original record fields and relationships retained; Volume II additions have explicit source pages.
Undated and approximate events remain reference history, not precise simulator triggers.
The reconstruction sequence completion status is unresolved; its stated narrative facts are preserved without treating it as played.
Mechanics and reference facts are all-time source material, not automatic annual state changes.

locations.name: Pyrothar
locations.description: Released force, elemental energy and destructive or transformative magical discharge.

locations.name: Aquenaleth
locations.description: Connection, passage and calling matter or beings across boundaries.

locations.name: Terravalor
locations.description: Changing matter, reshaping stone and adapting physical forms.

locations.name: Zephyros
locations.description: Appearances, shifting perception and echoes of things that once existed.

locations.name: Umbrathis
locations.description: Death and the spiritual residue of Krynn’s destruction.

locations.name: Luminara
locations.description: Possible futures, visions and patterns in fractures of time.

locations.name: Eldarion
locations.description: Will, feeling, memory and the influence of minds upon one another.

locations.name: Krynn
locations.description: The world that preceded Arcanus. Tiamat was bound to its foundations for an unknown reason. Activation of the First Key destroyed it; no definitive year is assigned.

locations.name: Arcanus
locations.description: Formed from the energies and surviving fragments of Krynn around Tiamat’s imprisonment. Its structure sustains both the world and the confinement.

locations.name: Arcanium
locations.description: The metaphysical meeting point of the Eight Realms, with eight spires, libraries and the Primordial Crystal. A threshold and regulator of magical exchange, not a ninth magical-school realm.

locations.name: Dracarnia
locations.description: The dragon realm outside the Leyline Lattice and the Eight-school structure. Dracaryn is an earlier archived draft name.

locations.name: Tomb of the First Paladin
locations.description: At Kaddinghall; its significance extends beyond ordinary religious history. The Key Nexus lies beneath the tomb and Dawnspire.

locations.name: Dawnspire
locations.description: Named with the Tomb of the First Paladin above Kaddinghall’s Key Nexus. This volume does not specify its structure or construction date.

locations.name: Island Nexus (unnamed)
locations.description: An island Nexus linked directly to the Arcanium, associated with Malcolm’s planned second Arcane Syphon. The island’s name and geographical position are not supplied.

factions.name: Dwarven guardians of Sternia
factions.description: Sternia’s dwarven ancestors were appointed guardians of a vulnerable lattice point. The duty survived through ages; its exact appointment date is not recorded.

factions.name: White Flight
factions.description: The flight Dragotha brings to Kaddinghall in the planned final struggle. The intervention remains campaign material, not completed history.

events.name: Arcanium reconstruction and briefing sequence
events.description: The later campaign sequence spans five Arcanium days and thirty-five outside years, from 793 to 828 A.F. The Observer in this sequence is secretly Tiamat. The participants are not listed and the volume does not explicitly establish whether the sequence has been played.
events.review_reason: Narrative facts are recorded, but completion/play status is unclear; not applied as completed history.

mechanics.name: First Key of Existence
mechanics.description: The instrument whose activation destroyed Krynn and established the prison-world. It is distinct from the later Eighteenfold Key.

mechanics.name: Eighteenfold Key
mechanics.description: The Second Key of Existence stabilises the prison. Its design has eighteen elements: sixteen associated with the Eight Realms, two per realm, plus exceptional elements associated with Tiamat and Dragotha. Correct reassembly and installation restore lattice stability; this is not a simple means of opening the prison.

mechanics.name: Primordial Crystal
mechanics.description: A surviving remnant of Krynn at the heart of the Arcanium; the central regulator of the Eight Realms’ magical forces. Access through a damaged Nexus would threaten the wider lattice.

mechanics.name: Leyline Lattice
mechanics.description: Carries magical currents between realms. Its crossings form Nexuses; together they sustain Arcanus and confine Tiamat. Nexus damage can propagate through the structure. The lattice is not identical to the Shattered Veil.

mechanics.name: Control and Key Nexuses
mechanics.description: Control Nexuses direct or regulate flows; Key Nexuses occupy major concentrations of crossings and connect to the prison’s stabilising architecture. Their functions are not interchangeable.

mechanics.name: Arcane Syphon
mechanics.description: Draws power from leylines and Nexuses. Malcolm used Umbrathis obsidian to engineer its failure at Sternia in 793 A.F. The later island scheme remains separate from that established event.

mechanics.name: Arcanium time
mechanics.description: One day inside the Arcanium corresponds to approximately seven years outside. Sula’s stay is given as 1,541 inside days and roughly 10,787 outside years. Approximate ancient dates and the stated time relationship are preserved; no new calendar conversion is imposed.

mechanics.name: First Law
mechanics.description: A being belonging to Arcanus cannot knowingly and willingly act with the direct purpose of destroying the world itself. This restrains intent, not cruelty or unintended catastrophic consequences. Its exact application to every god, external visitor and artefact is not settled here.

mechanics.name: Shattered Veil
mechanics.description: Distinct from the Leyline Lattice. It has not been definitively sealed in the current campaign. No exact date or fuller mechanism is supplied by this volume.

mechanics.name: Eighteenfold Key altar or locus
mechanics.description: The intended installation locus of the completed Key. Its precise physical design is still developing; no historical construction date is established.

review_issues.name: Has the reconstruction sequence been played?
review_issues.description: Page 16 describes the five-day / 35-year sequence; page 20 keeps the 828 finale planned. These do not prove whether this separate sequence has already been played. Preserve its stated range and identity revelation, but do not count it as completed history without a canon decision.

review_issues.name: Ancient dates remain approximate or unknown
review_issues.description: No precise First Dawn or Krynn-destruction year is supplied; Sula’s ancient dates are approximate. Do not manufacture precise dates or derive new ones from elapsed time.

review_issues.name: Final altar design remains developing
review_issues.description: The design is a developing prop/scenario element, not a confirmed physical design or dated historical construction.

review_issues.name: First Law edge cases are not settled
review_issues.description: Do not extend the rule to every god, outside visitor or artefact without a separate canon decision.

review_issues.name: Island name and position are not recorded
review_issues.description: The planned Syphon’s island Nexus is linked directly to the Arcanium, but no island name or map position is supplied in this volume.
